## api/thunderbird_contacts_mcp.py

### `contacts_create`
Create a new contact. Minimum: given_name + family_name.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `given_name` | `str` | ✅ |  | Contact's first / given name |
| `family_name` | `str` | ✅ |  | Contact's last / family name |
| `email` | `str` |  |  | Primary email address |
| `phone` | `str` |  |  | Primary phone number |
| `organization` | `str` |  |  | Company or organization name |

**Example call:**
```json
{
  "tool": "contacts_create",
  "arguments": {
    "given_name": "<given_name>",
    "family_name": "<family_name>"
  }
}
```

### `contacts_get`
Get full details for a specific contact by resource name.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `resource_name` | `str` | ✅ |  | Contact resource name, e.g. 'people/c12345' |

**Example call:**
```json
{
  "tool": "contacts_get",
  "arguments": {
    "resource_name": "people/c12345"
  }
}
```

### `contacts_list`
List all contacts with pagination.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page_size` | `int` |  | 50 | Number of contacts per page (1-200) |

**Example call:**
```json
{
  "tool": "contacts_list",
  "arguments": {
    "page_size": 50
  }
}
```

### `contacts_search`
Search contacts by name, email, or phone number.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | `str` | ✅ |  | Search query — matches name, email, or phone number |
| `page_size` | `int` |  | 20 | Maximum results to return (1-100) |

**Example call:**
```json
{
  "tool": "contacts_search",
  "arguments": {
    "query": "<query>",
    "page_size": 20
  }
}
```

### `contacts_update`
Update an existing contact's fields. Only non-empty fields are updated.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `resource_name` | `str` | ✅ |  | Contact resource name to update, e.g. 'people/c12345' |
| `given_name` | `str` |  |  | New first / given name (leave empty to keep current) |
| `family_name` | `str` |  |  | New last / family name (leave empty to keep current) |
| `email` | `str` |  |  | New primary email address (leave empty to keep current) |
| `phone` | `str` |  |  | New primary phone number (leave empty to keep current) |
| `organization` | `str` |  |  | New organization name (leave empty to keep current) |

**Example call:**
```json
{
  "tool": "contacts_update",
  "arguments": {
    "resource_name": "people/c12345"
  }
}
```

### `maps_static_map_url`
Generate a Google Static Maps URL for embedding in itineraries and web pages.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `center` | `str` |  |  | Center of the map: address or 'lat,lng' (e.g. 'Denver, CO' or '39.7392,-104.9903'). Required if markers_json is empty. |
| `markers_json` | `str` |  |  | JSON array of marker locations, e.g. ["Denver, CO", "39.7392,-104.9903"]. If provided without center, map auto-centers on markers. |
| `zoom` | `int` |  | 10 | Map zoom level (0=world, 21=building). Default 10. |
| `size` | `str` |  | 600x400 | Image dimensions in pixels, e.g. '600x400' or '800x600'. Max 640x640 free tier. |
| `maptype` | `str` |  | roadmap | Map type: 'roadmap', 'satellite', 'terrain', or 'hybrid' |

**Example call:**
```json
{
  "tool": "maps_static_map_url",
  "arguments": {
    "zoom": 10,
    "size": "600x400",
    "maptype": "roadmap"
  }
}
```

## api/thunderbird_sheets_mcp.py

### `sheets_append_row`
Append one or more rows to the end of a sheet.

| `spreadsheet_id` | `str` | ✅ |  | Google Sheets spreadsheet ID |
| `sheet_name` | `str` | ✅ |  | Sheet tab name (e.g. 'Sheet1') |
| `values_json` | `str` | ✅ |  | JSON array of values for one row: ["col1", "col2"]
OR array of arrays for multiple rows: [["a","b"],["c","d"]]
The API auto-detects the append position. |

{
  "tool": "sheets_append_row",

    "sheet_name": "Sheet1",
    "values_json": "<values_json>"
  }
}

Read cell data from a sheet range. Returns a 2D array of values.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `spreadsheet_id` | `str` | ✅ |  | Google Sheets spreadsheet ID |
| `sheet_name` | `str` | ✅ |  | Sheet tab name (e.g. 'Sheet1') |

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `spreadsheet_id` | `str` | ✅ |  | Google Sheets spreadsheet ID |
| `sheet_name` | `str` | ✅ |  | Sheet tab name (e.g. 'Sheet1') |
| `range_str` | `str` | ✅ |  | A1 notation range to write to (e.g. 'A1:C3'). Must be provided — the write target. |
| `values_json` | `str` | ✅ |  | JSON array of arrays with cell values. Example: [["Name","Age"],["Alice","30"],["Bob","25"]] |

**Example call:**
```json
{
  "tool": "sheets_write_data",
  "arguments": {
    "spreadsheet_id": "<spreadsheet_id>",
    "sheet_name": "Sheet1",
    "range_str": "A1:C3",
    "values_json": "<values_json>"
  }
}
```

### `generate_guest_form_drafts`

| `dossier_path` | `Optional[str]` |  | PydanticField(None, description='Absolute path to the dossier .md file. Auto-discovered from client_name if omitted.') |  |
| `force` | `bool` |  | PydanticField(False, description='Re-create drafts even if guest forms have already been sent for this booking.') |  |

**Example call:**
```json
{
  "tool": "generate_guest_form_drafts",
  "arguments": {
    "client_name": "PydanticField(..., description=\"Client surname or booking key (e.g. 'Furlow', 'McLeod', 'Kuklinski')\")",
    "dossier_path": "PydanticField(None, description='Absolute path to the dossier .md file. Auto-discovered from client_name if omitted.')",
    "force": "PydanticField(False, description='Re-create drafts even if guest forms have already been sent for this booking.')"
  }
}
```

## core/client/thunderbird_quote_render.py

### `render_quote_pdf`
Render a branded D2M quote PDF for any product type.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `quote_type` | `str` | ✅ |  | Quote type: 'flight', 'hotel', 'tour', or 'cruise' |
| `client_name` | `str` | ✅ |  | Client name |
| `options_json` | `str` | ✅ |  | JSON array of option objects. Structure depends on quote_type:
FLIGHT: option, airline, cabin, client_price, badges[], seats_remaining, legs[{label, segments[{dep_time, dep_airport, arr_time, arr_airport, duration, stops, flight_num}]}]
HOTEL: option, name, category, zone, room, board, per_night_client, client_total, cancellation, badges[]
TOUR: option, name, source, type, duration, rating, client_price, short_description, pictures[], badges[], consumer_price, savings
CRUISE: option, ship, stateroom_category, stateroom_number, deck, embark_date, disembark_date, embark_port, disembark_port, ports[], inclusions, client_price, deposit, badges[] |
| `comparison_json` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | JSON array of comparison row objects. Include is_pick (bool) to highlight recommended row. Columns vary by type — see d2m_quote.html.j2 template. |
| `destination` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Destination (hotel/tour/cruise) |
| `origin_city` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Origin city (flight) |
| `destination_city` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Destination city (flight) |
| `departure_date` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Departure date (flight) |
| `return_date` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Return date (flight, optional) |
| `check_in` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Check-in date (hotel) |
| `check_out` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Check-out date (hotel) |
| `nights` | `Optional[int]` |  |  | Number of nights (hotel/cruise) |
| `travel_dates` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Travel dates string (tour) |
| `sailing_dates` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Sailing dates string (cruise) |
| `cruise_line` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Cruise line name (cruise) |
| `itinerary_name` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Itinerary name (cruise) |
| `travelers` | `str` |  | 2 | Number of travelers |
| `recommendation` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Recommendation text |
| `notes` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Important notes/disclaimers |
| `output_filename` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Output PDF filename |

**Example call:**
```json
{
  "tool": "render_quote_pdf",
  "arguments": {
    "quote_type": "<quote_type>",
    "client_name": "<client_name>",
    "options_json": "<options_json>",
    "travelers": "2"
  }
}
```

## core/travel/thunderbird_fare_watch.py

### `fare_watch_add`
Add a new flight, cruise, or hotel fare to the price watch list.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `watch_id` | `str` | ✅ |  | Unique ID (e.g. 'allegiant-cos-sna-apr10') |
| `watch_type` | `str` |  | flight | Type: 'flight', 'cruise', or 'hotel' |
| `label` | `str` | ✅ |  | Human label (e.g. 'G4-3212 COS>SNA Apr 10 2026') |
| `provider` | `str` | ✅ |  | Provider (e.g. 'Allegiant', 'Silversea') |
| `route` | `str` | ✅ |  | Route (e.g. 'COS>SNA', 'Lisbon>Barcelona') |
| `travel_date` | `str` | ✅ |  | Travel date YYYY-MM-DD |
| `current_price_pp` | `float` | ✅ |  | Current price per person USD |
| `passengers` | `int` |  | 2 | Number of travelers |
| `alert_below` | `Optional[float]` |  |  | Alert if price drops below |
| `alert_above` | `Optional[float]` |  |  | Alert if price rises above |
| `notes` | `str` |  |  | Bundle details, add-on fees, etc. |

**Example call:**
```json
{
  "tool": "fare_watch_add",
  "arguments": {
    "watch_id": "allegiant-cos-sna-apr10",
    "watch_type": "flight",
    "label": "G4-3212 COS>SNA Apr 10 2026",
    "provider": "Allegiant",
    "route": "COS>SNA",
    "travel_date": "<travel_date>",
    "current_price_pp": 1.0,
    "passengers": 2
  }
}
```

### `render_flight_quote_pdf`
Render a branded D2M flight quote PDF from flight comparison data.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `client_name` | `str` | ✅ |  | Client name for the quote |
| `origin_city` | `str` | ✅ |  | Origin city name (e.g. 'Denver') |
| `destination_city` | `str` | ✅ |  | Destination city name (e.g. 'Tokyo') |
| `departure_date` | `str` | ✅ |  | Departure date (human-readable, e.g. 'April 1, 2026') |
| `return_date` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Return date (human-readable). Omit for one-way. |
| `travelers` | `str` |  | 2 | Number of travelers (as string for display) |
| `flights_json` | `str` | ✅ |  | JSON array of flight option objects. Each must have: option (int), airline (str), cabin (str), client_price (str like '$1,234.00'), badges (array of str), seats_remaining (int or null), legs (array of {label, segments: [{dep_time, dep_airport, arr_time, arr_airport, duration, stops, flight_num}]}) |
| `comparison_json` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | JSON array of comparison row objects for the table. Each: option, airline, departure, arrival, duration, stops, cabin, client_price, is_pick (bool) |
| `recommendation` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Recommendation text paragraph for the client |
| `notes` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Important notes (e.g. 'Prices valid for 24 hours. Fares subject to change.') |
| `output_filename` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Output PDF filename. Defaults to ClientName_Route_MonYYYY.pdf |

**Example call:**
```json
{
  "tool": "render_flight_quote_pdf",
  "arguments": {
    "client_name": "<client_name>",
    "origin_city": "Denver",
    "destination_city": "Tokyo",
    "departure_date": "April 1, 2026",
    "travelers": "2",
    "flights_json": "<flights_json>"
  }
}
```

### `search_flights`
Search for flight offers via the Amadeus API.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `origin` | `str` | ✅ |  | Origin airport IATA code (e.g. 'LAX', 'DEN', 'JFK') |
| `destination` | `str` | ✅ |  | Destination airport IATA code (e.g. 'NRT', 'LHR', 'CDG') |
| `departure_date` | `str` | ✅ |  | Departure date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `return_date` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Return date (YYYY-MM-DD) for round-trip. Omit for one-way. |
| `adults` | `int` |  | 1 | Number of adult passengers (1-9) |
| `children` | `int` |  | 0 | Number of child passengers 2-11 (0-8) |
| `infants` | `int` |  | 0 | Number of infant passengers under 2 (0-4) |
| `cabin_class` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Cabin class filter: ECONOMY, PREMIUM_ECONOMY, BUSINESS, FIRST. Omit for all classes. |
| `nonstop_only` | `bool` |  | False | Only return non-stop flights |
| `max_results` | `int` |  | 10 | Maximum number of offers to return (1-250) |
| `max_price` | `Optional[int]` |  |  | Maximum price per traveler in USD |
| `currency` | `str` |  | USD | Price currency code (default USD) |

**Example call:**
```json
{
  "tool": "search_flights",
  "arguments": {
    "origin": "LAX",
    "destination": "NRT",
    "departure_date": "<departure_date>",
    "adults": 1,
    "children": 0,
    "infants": 0,
    "nonstop_only": false,
    "max_results": 10,
    "currency": "USD"
  }
}
```

### `search_google_flights`
Search flights via the Google Flights API (RapidAPI-hosted, free tier).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `departure_id` | `str` | ✅ |  | Origin IATA code, e.g. 'DEN'. Use google_flights_search_airport if unsure of the code. |
| `arrival_id` | `str` | ✅ |  | Destination IATA code, e.g. 'ORD'. |
| `outbound_date` | `str` | ✅ |  | Departure date YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `return_date` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Return date YYYY-MM-DD for round-trip. Omit for one-way. |
| `travel_class` | `str` |  | ECONOMY | ECONOMY \| PREMIUM_ECONOMY \| BUSINESS \| FIRST |
| `adults` | `int` |  | 1 | Number of adult passengers |
| `currency` | `str` |  | USD | Price currency code (default USD) |
| `search_type` | `str` |  | best | 'best' (balanced) or 'cheap' (lowest cost, may have longer layovers) |
| `list_all_top` | `bool` |  | False | If true, also return every itinerary in Google's 'top' (recommended) set, not just the single cheapest — use this to find a specific carrier/nonstop that isn't the lowest-price option. |

**Example call:**
```json
{
  "tool": "search_google_flights",
  "arguments": {
    "departure_id": "DEN",
    "arrival_id": "ORD",
    "outbound_date": "<outbound_date>",
    "travel_class": "ECONOMY",
    "adults": 1,
    "currency": "USD",
    "search_type": "best",
    "list_all_top": false
  }
}
```

### `render_tour_quote_pdf`
Render a branded D2M tour quote PDF with logo, headshot, and slogan.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `client_name` | `str` | ✅ |  | Client name for the quote |

| `travel_dates` | `str` | ✅ |  | Travel dates (human-readable, e.g. 'June 15-22, 2026') |
| `travelers` | `str` |  | 2 | Number of travelers |

| `notes` | `Optional[str]` |  |  | Important notes or disclaimers |

{
